tasks.label: Docker: Subir ambiente
tasks.detail: Builda (se preciso) e sobe postgres + backend + frontend, com logs no terminal.

tasks.label: Docker: Subir ambiente (segundo plano)
tasks.detail: Mesma coisa, mas em background — use 'Docker: Ver logs' para acompanhar.

tasks.label: Backend: Testes (pytest)
tasks.detail: Requer o container do backend rodando (Docker: Subir ambiente).
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python -m pytest

tasks.label: Backend: Lint (ruff check)
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend ruff check .

tasks.label: Backend: Format (ruff format)
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend ruff format .

tasks.label: Backend: Aplicar migrations
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python manage.py migrate

tasks.label: Backend: Criar migrations
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python manage.py makemigrations

tasks.label: Backend: Criar superusuário (admin)
tasks.detail: Cria um usuário admin do Django (acesso em /admin/) — vai pedir usuário/email/senha.
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python manage.py createsuperuser

tasks.label: Backend: Shell do Django
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python manage.py shell

tasks.label: Frontend: Testes (vitest)
tasks.detail: Requer o container do frontend rodando (Docker: Subir ambiente).
tasks.command: docker compose exec frontend npm test

tasks.label: Frontend: Lint (eslint)
tasks.command: docker compose exec frontend npm run lint

tasks.label: Frontend: Build de produção
tasks.command: docker compose exec frontend npm run build

tasks.label: Testes: Backend + Frontend
tasks.detail: Roda a suíte completa dos dois serviços — equivalente ao que a CI deve checar.
